blog.title: OUR HAVEN
blog.desc:
When our plants sprawl as sage-like trees

and we nestle by the fire with tea,

with our newest treasures from the local bookstore

post a warm, home-cooked meal


And as we talk into the sunset

under the roar of the nearby creek,

the honey rays and breeze are dancing

in the garden you grew for me 


Where the witty fox enriches our banter

and the squirrels our carefree spree,

where gold-crowned mushrooms sprout in clusters 

and I learn to befriend the bees


Where the cats’ wide-eyed gazes follow

the swirling fish in the pond,

where deer teach us the language of softness

And of patience, the heron

\
The night sky deepens outside our window

and drapes its tapestry of stars,

as slumber sinks the moonlight glitters

on this little haven of ours
